bench_optimization: -O2 -DNDEBUG (native benchmark objects; no LTO to preserve the real cross-TU call boundary)
clock: std::chrono::steady_clock; Apple-Silicon monotonic tick ~41.7 ns (24 MHz timebase)
timing_method: each sample = mean of an inner batch of 512 calls (sub-tick single calls unresolvable); percentiles over the batch-mean distribution
